answer: To resist Sybils, each agent registers as a unique vertex anchored to a cryptographic attestation chain. Agents emit verifiable activity tickets using zero-knowledge proofs validated against a global beacon. Every additional clone in a swarm multiplies identity staking costs by an exponential factor O(k^n). Fast-moving comet transactions without bonded attestations face exponential capital exhaustion, making mass swarm creation mathematically unprofitable.
